feature_contract.goal: Complete the visible OutRun front-end menu picture aspect and placement across normal LOCAL projection and mono recovery theater when the original game window is partially outside a duplicated display.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only mono fallback window-fragment projection changes; existing full-window menu optics, stereo SBS seam, 3D world, F11, ESC, HUD, SkyGlow, input and DX11/DXVK are untouched.
trace_stages: Original game menu client bounds are transformed to the selected DXGI output and clipped into GetGameUv.
The R23 mono recovery theater blits those captured UV pixels, while the normal LOCAL menu uses authored 4:3 optical coordinates.
The recovered mono XrCompositionLayerQuad now retains visible fragment physical scale and camera-local translation under the existing theater anchor/recenter.
subcomponents: Preserve original full-client optical scale for both axes of a partly captured mono theater quad and correct its projected physical aspect.
Translate only the surviving pixel fragment along the existing world-locked LOCAL theater axes while preserving clean full-window, stale-capture and SBS fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Fully visible 4:3 and ultrawide menu retains baseline; left/right/top/corner clipped original menu pixels have correct physical size and stable offset under an existing optical anchor.
Stale/invalid/nonfinite/no-output capture is rejected; SBS half-view, world stereo, gameplay HUD, F11, SkyGlow and desktop full-window paths do not use mono fragment rebasing.
Canonical exact-SHA DX9Ex Active policy/host/game/full-chain/package plus Domain and relevant Full Source Impact succeed without claiming Quest3 runtime.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Source R23RenderTheater used complete GetClientRect aspect for an image cropped by GetGameUv when the menu/game window was partly off the duplicated output; full theater quad recentered the remaining pixels.
source_trace: Original menu/game pixel client rectangle is returned in selected DXGI output coordinates by GetGameClientOutputRect.
GetGameUv clips that rectangle to output bounds and RenderTo blits only surviving image pixels into theater swapchain.
R23RenderTheater submits an XrCompositionLayerQuad in LOCAL space using a reused theaterAnchor; this change scales and offsets exactly that visible fragment.
diagnosis.root_cause: The fallback render path derived quad aspect/centre from the original full window but sampled a partially clipped UV, so the surviving pixels stretched and shifted to the original full quad.
alternatives_rejected: The main LOCAL-fixed menu crop already accounts for clipped UV and must not be reimplemented here.
Global OpenXR projection or eye extent changes risk normal 3D stereo and do not repair mono theater geometry.
SBS source split has a distinct virtual centre seam; retain its established unchanged fallback.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: OpenXR host R23RenderTheater applies geometrically correct fragment size and LOCAL offset only for verified clipped mono GetGameUv; built and executed new portable host smoke on Windows exact material SHA.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Expanded portable menu-content-aspect smoke covers full/left/right/top/corner and stale/nonfinite/no-intersection UV; exact-SHA DX9Ex Active host smoke and full Win32 game/host/package all SUCCESS at material SHA.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: R23 mono fallback is XR_EYE_VISIBILITY_BOTH from one original client fragment and unchanged LOCAL theaterAnchor. The regular two-eye LOCAL menu, SBS and world stereo are not touched.

remaining: All mandatory automated source/package gates PASS on validation-bearing material SHA; Quest3/VDXR mono recovery/menu visual, FPS and headset recenter acceptance remain NEED_HMD_TEST. No runtime PASS claimed.
